items.html: Afterwards, the light of Malchut came out to reign in her vessel. She reigned there and broke, and then her light ascended in Daat through the middle line, too, and her vessel descended in Hesed of Beria. Now the vessel Tifferet is in the place of Keter of Beria, and the vessel Malchut is in the place of Hesed of Beria. It follows that the place between a vessel and a vessel of Beria is only three degrees, which are HBD. In Atzilut, however, there is no vacant place, but only two degrees, which are the place of Yesod and Malchut.
